notes: Park Commission minutes, 1949 volume (the separate Park Commission before the 1950 merger, mostly maintenance contracts). Curated; dated by the page footers (m/d/yy) and the meeting openers.

coverage.remaining: War-years repair contracts, wartime uses of parks, and works with no page (Sutro Heights diorama house, the Golden Gate Park orchid house, Bufano statues at Aquatic Park) not placed.

findings.address_as_written: Master Plan for the development of the Rhododendron and Fern Dells
findings.description: The Park Commission engaged the landscape architect Andrew Gotzenberg to prepare a master plan for the Rhododendron and Fern Dells in Golden Gate Park, for no more than $1,500.

citation.label: Minutes of the Park Commission, January 26, 1949, Resolution No. 1690

raw.text: Master Plan for the development of the Rhododendron and Fern Dells
